# Dora

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P6](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0006), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P47](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0047)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Dora is a neat and proper character with a straight nose and gentle, mild hazel eyes. She wears long, sleek curls that never get out of order. Her attire includes a nicely starched white dress paired with a black sash.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044)_

## Personality

Dora is a quiet, good, and extremely well-behaved child. Known for being neat, faithful, and observant, she never needs to be told how to do a task twice and meticulously attends to all her duties. She is exceptionally industrious, finding great happiness in helping with small household chores suited to her chubby fingers. In all her activities, including gardening, she acts carefully, systematically, and dispassionately, maintaining a composed demeanor even under stress. Characterized as prim, demure, and proper, she consistently conducts herself in a polite manner, usually speaking only when spoken to.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P88](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0088), +8 more_

## History

Dora was an orphaned twin who was brought to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) alongside her brother [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), whose wild behavior contrasted with her own perfect conduct. Early on, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) subjected her to various tricks, including pushing her into a pigpen and later locking her inside Mr. Harrison's toolhouse, where [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) eventually rescued her after a frantic search. Despite her quiet and well-behaved demeanor, both [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) privately admitted to preferring her mischievous brother over her. Following the death of their uncle [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md), a trust fund was established for Dora and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), guaranteeing that they could remain permanently at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P4](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0004), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P7](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0007), +333 more_

## Relationships

### [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--dora.md)

[Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) is Dora's twin brother, who arrived with her at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) after being orphaned. Despite being siblings, Dora's quiet, perfect behavior contrasts sharply with Davy's relentless mischief, which often targets her directly. He frequently subjects her to tricks, such as tricking her into falling into a pigpen, attempting to pump water on her, and locking her inside Mr. Harrison's toolhouse.

- Sibling of — twin brother and sister  <sub>[v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), +7 more</sub>

### [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dora--paul-irving.md)

[Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) is an imaginative young friend of the [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) household who shares a mutual fondness with Dora. Dora visits [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) for tea alongside [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) during a trip to the shore. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) also regularly discuss [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) during mealtime conversations at home.

- Friend of — mutual fondness  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P20](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0020)</sub>
